 Principal Site Reliability Engineer
 Remote - USA; Santa Clara, California, USA
 Apply 
 Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
 We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
 Role 
We are looking for a Principal Site Reliability Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role going into the Santa Clara, CA office 3 days a week or Remote (US) role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Operations in the Infrastructure services and architecture team. As a lead engineer, you will leverage deep expertise in IaC/CaC, Linux virtualization, and physical hardware management to drive our infrastructure forward. You will oversee networking services and general software engineering to ensure our systems remain scalable, resilient, and high-performing.
 What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 
• Mentor other engineers and lead high-impact infrastructure projects
• Support business operations by responding to alerts and triaging systems to restore mission-critical capabilities
• Ensure the reliability and performance of all customer-facing services
• Design, document, and build technical solutions that align with evolving organizational needs
• Support Agile processes to maintain high velocity and a collaborative environment
 Who You Are (Success Profile) 
• You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path forward in a dynamic environment where you see uncertainty as an opportunity to build something meaningful.
• You act like an owner with a strong bias for action and deep integrity, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to drive outstanding outcomes.
• You are a continuous learner who actively seeks feedback, possesses a growth mindset, and approaches your work with purpose to constantly develop as a teammate and partner.
• You are a positive force, bringing constructive energy and a collaborative "can-do" spirit to complex challenges, inspiring your team to maintain focus on the solution.
• You are data-driven, leveraging analytics to uncover truth, measure what matters, and replace assumptions with evidence to make informed decisions.
 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 
• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
• Proven experience using Git within a structured SDLC
• Hands-on experience with Enterprise Linux distributions such as Rocky, Red Hat, or Alma
• Deep professional experience with Terraform and Ansible
• Expert-level programming skills in Python or Go
• U.S. citizenship due to the nature of the customers assigned to this role
 What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 
• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
• Deep knowledge of Linux Hypervisors, including OpenStack, Proxmox, libvirt, or QEMU
• Technical experience working with FreeBSD
• Familiarity with Identity Access Management tools like HashiCorp Vault, LDAP, or OIDC
